notes: TBox contraction paired with physics-replace-0006: removes the original rule of that revision ("every first-class lever has its fulcrum in the middle, between the effort and the load"). Stored facts only; no indeterminate queries. Definitional removal (the fulcrum in the middle is what makes a lever first-class); slice results as definitional. The three derived queries name made-up levers, each stated to be first-class (they ask which element is in the middle, whether the load is, and which to put in the middle) (inheritance, 2 hops); after the removal nothing else the model holds answers them, so the target is "does not know". Propositional targets follow strong Kleene logic and all become unknown. Near and far unrelated queries are kept from the revision (contraction is exempt from Rule 7). Residual risk: a model may still answer the fulcrum from the term "first-class lever".
